source_title: 'Premada Oorali' BO day 35: Shree Raam film nears 'KGF: Chapter 2'
source_excerpt: Kannada film 'Premada Oorali' continues to attract audiences even after completing five weeks in theaters. The Shree Raam and Thapaswini Poonacha-starrer has recorded Rs 128.39 cr in worldwide gross collections. Its domestic net earnings have reached Rs 106.72 cr, bringing it close to the reported opening-day collection of Yash's blockbuster 'KGF: Chapter 2'.According to Sacnilk, 'Premada Oorali' collected Rs 85 lakh net in India on Thursday, October 29. The amount came from 841 shows, with an average earning of Rs 10,107 per screening. Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 124.74 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 5 lakh on Day 35, taking the cumulative international gross to Rs 3.65 cr.'Premada Oorali' box office collection: Comparison with 'KGF: Chapter 2'The film's domestic performance has invited comparisons with 'KGF: Chapter 2', which recorded a reported Day 1 collection of Rs 116 cr. Its language-wise opening figures were Rs 22.85 cr from Kannada, Rs 53.95 cr from Hindi, Rs 4.90 cr from Malayalam, Rs 7.90 cr from Tamil and Rs 26.40 cr from Telugu.At the end of 25 days, 'KGF: Chapter 2' had accumulated Rs 813.85 cr in India net collections. Its domestic gross stood at Rs 947.20 cr, while overseas markets contributed Rs 193 cr. The worldwide gross collection had reached Rs 1,140.20 cr.With its current India net earnings, 'Premada Oorali' remains Rs 9.28 cr below the reported opening-day figure of Kannada cinema's milestone film 'KGF: Chapter 2', as per Sacnilk. 'Premada Oorali' daily box office collection: Week fiveThe movie began its fifth week with Rs 2.10 cr on Friday, October 23. Saturday brought in Rs 3 cr, followed by Rs 3.75 cr on Sunday. Monday's collection stood at Rs 2.25 cr, while Tuesday contributed Rs 1.30 cr.The film earned Rs 1.10 cr on Wednesday before adding Rs 85 lakh on Thursday. This represents a 22.7% decline from the previous day's collection. Morning screenings registered 11.67%, while afternoon shows recorded 22.67%. Evening occupancy reached 23.08%, followed by 21.75% during night shows. The film attracted 64,074 admissions on its thirty-fifth day. Its cumulative footfalls across India have reached 7,188,961. Evening screenings recorded the highest occupancy among the four show timings.'Premada Oorali': Cast, crew and story details'Premada Oorali' features Shree Raam, Thapaswini Poonacha and Ramika Shivu in lead roles. Rangayana Raghu appears in a supporting role. Sunaad Gowtham has composed the musical score, while Rajkanth S.K. handled cinematography. Harshith Prabhu is responsible for editing.Set in picturesque villages during the 2020s, the movie revolves around a love story with elements of family drama.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources.
